editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Libertex is a legitimate CySEC-regulated broker scoring 7.0/10 from NAFT in 2026. Operated by Indication Investments Ltd under the Libertex Group (founded 1997), it offers a unique zero-spread commission-only pricing model across 300+ CFD instruments plus 300+ real stocks commission-free. The commission model provides genuine transparency — you always know your cost upfront — but at approximately $12 round-turn per standard lot on EUR/USD, it is more expensive than raw-spread ECN brokers. CySEC regulation with EU passporting provides solid protection for EEA clients. Best for European traders who prioritize cost certainty over absolute lowest cost.
